parent.notes: Adds an SOS notification and Children tab ordering. The app reads the SOS alerts recorded on the server, so an SOS is not missed when a normal location report arrives right after it, and shows one urgent notification per SOS, also when the app is closed and background alerts are on. On the Children tab the child who pressed SOS last is shown first and the one before second. Includes the pre-filled server address from v1.4.16. Login, billing and all other features are unchanged. Signed ARM + ARM64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. No phone testing claimed.

client.notes: Adds 32-bit ARM support. Previous APKs lacked the 32-bit Flutter engine and app library; this may explain launch failure on 32-bit Android. All features are unchanged from v24 (source diff: build and version files only). Retest pending on a 32-bit phone. Signed ARM + ARM64 + x86-64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. Not tested on a physical phone.

tiffe_staff.notes: Live Kitchen now lists every order in New Orders, Preparing and Ready for Pickup whatever its delivery date, with the delivery date on each card. The cooking totals still count the delivery date of today only. In All Orders the Today filter also shows orders placed today. Payment, login and role code are unchanged. Not tested on a phone.

tiffe.notes: The Update button now downloads and installs the APK inside the app from this feed, with no Firebase page. The Payment pending text is removed from My Orders & Tiffins cards, so only the price shows. The app no longer changes order status or sends messages on its own timers; status changes only when staff update it in the Staff app. Payment, login and role code are unchanged. Signed APK after successful static analysis and tests. Not tested on a phone.
